{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Outer layer: a structured wool-blend trench coat, knee-length cut, deep charcoal gray (#2F3136), water-resistant technical fabric.
Top: an oversized silk-cotton blend blouse with dramatic puff sleeves and a high collar, hip-length fit, vibrant emerald green (#50C878), crinkle texture.
Bottom: wide-leg dark denim trousers with a slight stretch, full length reaching the ankle, midnight blue (#131E2D), heavy twill fabric.
Shoes: chunky platform loafers in glossy patent leather, mid-calf height, black (#000000).
Bag: a structured box clutch with a long chain strap, matte black finish, genuine leather.

This outfit works because it masterfully balances the practical need for rain protection with her bold desire to stand out in a cafe setting. The vibrant emerald blouse and oversized sleeves create an immediate visual statement that captures attention during a business casual meeting, while the dark trench coat ensures she remains dry and composed throughout the long rainy day. The wide-leg denim and chunky loafers offer a contemporary, stylish edge that elevates the look beyond standard office wear without sacrificing comfort or professionalism."}
